letter.company_line: Civil contractor in Perth hiring a Civil Engineering Technician
letter.subject: Civil Engineering Technician, Perth
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineering Technician role advertised on SEEK. Supporting project engineers with drawing review, quantities, site inspections and as-built records is close to the work I did on site and want to keep doing.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, tracked procurement and materials, and wrote site reports, material records and progress reports.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. My site experience is from the Philippines, and I have not yet worked on an Australian site.

I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Perth for the right role. I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
